quote: “A book must be the axe for the frozen sea inside us.”
source: Franz Kafka, Letters to Friends, Family, and Editors, to Oskar Pollak, 27 January 1904 (trans. Richard and Clara Winston, 1977)

evidence.where: Two quotation sites (WIST, The Marginalian) reproducing the Winston 1977 passage in full and naming the Schocken volume; the page number 16 was not independently confirmed so it is left out of the source
evidence.edition: Letters to Friends, Family, and Editors, Schocken Books, 1977, trans. Richard and Clara Winston

reason: The line is the Winston rendering of the 27 January 1904 letter to Pollak, word for word, in the 1977 Schocken collection. The full passage was checked; only the Schocken page number could not be confirmed and has been dropped.
